##### Project general facts

One by Binghatti is a distinguished development offering properties designed to provide residents with spacious and comfortable living environments, highlighted by modern interiors and high-quality finishes. The building features a unique façade with intricately designed balconies that offer privacy while ensuring ample natural light and ventilation. Utilizing modern construction techniques and architectural design, this exceptional project represents the perfect blend of contemporary elegance and functional living.

Residents have access to a wide range of amenities designed to enhance their lifestyle, including a fully equipped gymnasium for fitness enthusiasts and dedicated BBQ areas for social gatherings. The development provides round-the-clock security and concierge services for safety and convenience, along with secure parking facilities. Every amenity has been thoughtfully curated to create a seamless and enjoyable lifestyle experience.

Each residence features modern finishing with high-quality materials, creating living spaces that exude sophistication and contemporary elegance. The interiors are meticulously crafted with contemporary fixtures, premium materials, and sophisticated finishes, while kitchens are fully equipped with state-of-the-art appliances and sleek cabinetry. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a stylish and functional home environment.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is strategically positioned in Business Bay for excellent connectivity to major parts of Dubai, just minutes from Downtown Dubai, the Dubai Mall, and the iconic Burj Khalifa. The area is known to be a stylish and up-to-date community with the latest trends, offering a fast-paced lifestyle with music festivals, celebrations, and numerous events throughout the year. The neighborhood offers hotel towers, amazing restaurants, and wonderful residential properties that create a truly integrated urban environment.

The location provides convenient access to the city's extensive public transport network, with the metro station just a short walk away. Key destinations including Dubai International Airport, DIFC, the World Trade Centre, and Safa Park are all within easy reach. The area is surrounded by numerous dining, shopping, and entertainment options, including high-end restaurants, luxury retail outlets, and vibrant nightlife venues.

The neighborhood offers famous international schools, medical facilities, supermarkets, and banks and finance centers all within minutes of residents' homes. The convenient access to essential services and amenities elevates the standard of living with easy and intuitive options in close proximity. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of business hub connectivity, vibrant community living, and urban convenience, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most dynamic and desirable districts.
